newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen peaking again in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen peaking again in quiet market.

text.p: Danish share prices slipped marginally in early trade on Monday but dealers foresaw the KFX index hitting new records in a quiet, low turnover holiday market with positive undertone.
"The market undertone remains optimistic but I see lower turnover due to the industrial holiday. The KFX index should close at a new high nonetheless," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.14 point to 177.62 at 0735 GMT, having closed 2.11 point higher on Friday at a new all-time end-of-day record.
